text: Kingsmoor FC's tactical shift to press higher and play more direct after 65' aimed to swiftly overturn their 2-3 deficit by winning the ball earlier and accelerating attacks [#1187]. While pressing intensity rose from 0.5 to 0.68 and directness from 0.5 to 0.65, the desired effect on chance creation failed as their expected goals dropped to zero and possession decreased from 57.6% to 51.6% [#1187]. The doubled high turnovers from 2 to 4 indicate that increased risk-taking led to loss of control rather than dominance [#1187]. Coaching point: balance the urgency to press higher with careful risk management to avoid conceding possession cheaply when chasing a goal.
